project_name: Siwalatri Terpadu - Klungkung Harbour & Fast Boat Ticketing

layout_and_style_directions.landing_style: Visa Travels style: High-impact hero photo with masked editorial title, sticky glassmorphic bottom search bar strip with departure/destination date pickers and 'Cari Tiket' button. Editorial section title 'Pilih Destinasi Favorit', destination cards with live slot badges, carousel prev/next buttons, and slow editorial ticker marquee.
layout_and_style_directions.auth_style: Kreative style: Split screen modal/page. Left side features a high-res 3D Balinese ocean/fastboat artwork card with soft gradient badge. Right side features crisp form with bottom border line inputs, dark pill 'Masuk / Daftar' button, and Google OAuth option.
layout_and_style_directions.dashboard_style: Realty Hub style: Light grey canvas (#F8FAFC), sticky left navigation sidebar with dark pill active states and category badges, top header with harbour switcher (Dermaga Padangbai / Kusamba / Sampalan / Nusa Penida), soft pastel summary metric tiles (Trip Hari Ini, Total Penumpang, Retribusi, Cash/QRIS/VA mix), live feed right column, and 24px rounded cards with crisp subtle borders.

key_components_to_build.name: Public Landing Page
subcomponents: Header Navigation (Logo, Jadwal, Info, Partner, Kontak, Button Login/Register)
Hero Section with Masked Text & Search Strip
Pengumuman Banner (Informasi Cuaca & Gelombang BMKG Klungkung)
Jadwal Hari Ini Cards (Dermaga Asal/Tujuan, Jam WITA, Armada, Status Persiapan/Berlayar/Sandar)
Destinasi Cards Carousel (Goa Giri Putri, Crystal Bay, Pantai Atuh, Kelingking Beach)

key_components_to_build.name: Modul Tiket (Passenger Flow)
subcomponents: Search Zona & Filter Form (Asal, Tujuan, Tanggal, Jumlah Pass)
List Keberangkatan (Departure Cards with Cutoff Timer & Seat availability)

key_components_to_build.name: Modul Petugas & Officer Dashboard

External Fleets Live Monitor (Gangga Express, Sekar Jaya, The Angkal Fast Cruise)

Ticket Cutoff Time & SOP Approval Settings Modal

motion_and_effects.framer_motion: Staggered scroll triggers, smooth tab switches, slide-over order panels, and modal reveals

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include data-testid on interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, search, selectors).
Ensure high contrast readable text over images with dark overlay gradients (bg-slate-900/60).
Implement rich interactive sample state in React to allow seamless clicking through from booking to payment, e-ticket generation, and staff officer dashboard management.
